title: PorcineSow-HR-HP-MiniDemo: minimal data and baseline for 5-min heat production prediction in pregnant sows
description: Companion software and minimal feature dataset for a short paper section on predicting 5-min heat production (HP, kcal/5 min) in pregnant sows from heart-rate-derived metrics, inertial activity statistics, and body weight. The repository ships 24,139 five-minute windows from 14 sows, a 12-feature schema, and a single-config gradient-boosted-tree baseline that reproduces a 5-fold random-shuffle cross-validation R^2 of about 0.79 (MAE about 2.3 kcal/5 min).
